biography.description: A broad-shouldered man with an intense gaze and military bearing. Clean-shaven head, calloused hands. Wears a long armored coat and carries himself like he expects combat at any moment. Faint burn scars trace patterns across his forearms from a botched ritual years ago.
biography.background: Marcus served as a magical security consultant for Lone Star, specializing in anti-mage tactics and combat spellcasting. After a corporate cover-up got his partner killed, he went rogue and disappeared into the shadows. A hermetic magician trained at MIT&T, he approaches magic with analytical precision and devastating firepower. His specialties are combat and manipulation spells—he believes the best defense is an overwhelming offense.

system.description: The most popular heavy pistol in the world, especially among mercenaries and shadowrunners.
A compact taser designed for non-lethal takedowns. Popular with law enforcement and those who prefer their targets alive.
A long, heavy coat lined with ballistic materials. Provides excellent protection while maintaining a street-ready look.

system.gameEffect: Conjures a ball of fire that detonates in the area of effect, dealing Physical damage to all targets.
Channels a bolt of electricity at a single target, dealing Physical damage with the electricity element.
Channels destructive magical energy at a single target, causing Physical damage. Resisted by Body.
Area-effect version of Stunbolt. Stun damage to all targets in area of effect.
Creates a mystical barrier of protection around the subject, adding hits as armor.
Allows the caster to telekinetically lift and move a target (including themselves) through the air.
Covers an area with a frictionless sheet of ice, causing targets to lose their footing.
Increases target's Reaction and adds Initiative Dice. Each hit adds +1 Reaction and +1D6 Initiative.
Detects living beings within the spell's range. Useful for finding hidden enemies or survivors.
Changes the subject's appearance to the caster's specification. Physical illusion, affects cameras and sensors.

system.description: Can sustain spells without the normal -2 penalty, up to rating spells.
Character must make a Composure test to retreat from combat.
A heavy obsidian ring inscribed with hermetic glyphs. Channels raw magical power.
system.gameEffect: Adds Force as dice pool bonus to all magical tests.

system.description: A braided copper wristband etched with formulae. Amplifies combat spell potency.
system.gameEffect: Adds Force as dice pool bonus to combat spellcasting.

system.description: A medical kit for field treatment of injuries.
A standard flashlight, infrared and low-light capable.
A muscle car with decent speed and handling. Marcus keeps it tuned and ready for quick exits.
A veteran troll fixer who operates out of a downtown Seattle bar. Reliable, professional, and well-connected.
Former partner's widow. Still in Lone Star, feeds Marcus intel.
A dwarf street informant who keeps his ear to the ground in Redmond and Puyallup.
